messages.subject: Help installing rattle
messages.body_plain:
Dear Friends,

I tried installing rattle today.  Everything appeared to go without
error until I invoked rattle() at the R prompt.  I received the
following error message:

Error in rattle() : could not find function "gladeXMLNew"

I am using Linux Suse 10.2 and the most recent version of R.  I also
installed the most recent version of libglade.

Can anyone help?

Joe

messages.subject: add generic function to pmml package
messages.subject_clean: add generic function to pmml package
messages.body_plain:
I would like to propose to add just
this little S3 generic function to the
pmml package

pmml <- function(x, ...)
  UseMethod("pmml")

This will allow one to simply export
any model using

pmml(modelobj)

Regards,
Tobias

P.S. Example:

library(pmml)
pmml <- function(x, ...)
  UseMethod("pmml")
# kmeans example
x <- rbind(matrix(rnorm(100, sd = 0.3), ncol = 2), matrix(rnorm(100,
mean = 1, sd = 0.3), ncol = 2))
colnames(x) <- c("x", "y")
cl <- kmeans(x, 2)
pmml(cl)
# rpart example
fit <- rpart(Kyphosis ~ Age + Number + Start, data=kyphosis)
pmml(fit)

> avoid all of that "junk" in the top level environment, but couldn't
> get it working. Any specific examples/suggestions would be gladly
> received!
>

My knowledge does not extend beyond the following,
but maybe it's useful

# assigment in global environment
a <- 2
# create other environment
myenv <- new.env()
is.environment(myenv)
# assign in a specific environment
assign("a", 3, envir = myenv)
# search (global environment listed first on search path, myenv not listed)
a
# search for an object in a specific environment
get("a", envir = myenv)
# remove `a' from global environment
rm(a)
# attach environment to search path
attach(myenv)
# verify it is there..
search()
# search for `a' which now only resides in the myenv environment...
a
# ... but which is not visible in the global workspace
ls()

HTH,
Tobias

> Regards,
> Graham
